sentences.speaker: Eli
sentences.text: My summary says the city will incarcerate everyone who breaks the curfew.

sentences.speaker: Petra
sentences.text: Check the heading. That paragraph is a proposal from one councillor, not the current rule.

sentences.speaker: Eli
sentences.text: The next paragraph says the city currently uses warnings and fines, not incarceration.

sentences.speaker: Petra
sentences.text: Exactly. Can you try the summary again with that distinction?

sentences.speaker: Eli
sentences.text: One councillor proposes a prison penalty, but the city has not adopted it and currently uses warnings and fines.

sentences.speaker: Petra
sentences.text: That matches the case sheet. Keep the proposal and the present practice separate.
